reported.quote: IPO proceeds exceeded US$9 billion or INR86,500 crores in the July to September quarter, highest ever for this period.
The industry added approximately 32.7 lakh accounts in August, the highest monthly addition in 7 months.
By the end of September, the overall Demat account base has reached approximately 24 crores.
CDSL continued to account for approximately 80%+of the industry's demat accounts with about 19.34 crores accounts by the end of September 2026.
For the 6 months ended September 30, 2026, the total income is achieved at INR685.21 crores as against INR602.26 crores for the 6 months of the previous year.
The standalone net profit for the 6 months, is achieved at INR307.79 crores as against INR279.51 crores for the first half of the previous year.

reported.metric: Standalone total income for second quarter
reported.quote: In terms of quarterly numbers, the stand-alone total income is at INR358.70 crores as against INR289.90 crores for the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

reported.metric: Standalone net profit for second quarter
reported.quote: The standalone net profit for second quarter is INR163.34 crores as against INR127.50 crores for the corresponding quarter of the previous year.
On a consolidated total income for 6 months ended 30th September 2026 is achieved at INR757.80 crores as against INR636.53 crores of the first half of the previous year.
The consolidated net profit for the 6 months ended September 30th is at INR290.97 crores as against INR242.34 crores for the previous year.

reported.metric: Consolidated total income for second quarter
reported.quote: For the second quarter on a consolidated basis, the total income is achieved at INR417.30 crores, which is against INR341.57 crores for the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

reported.metric: Consolidated net profit for second quarter
reported.quote: And the net profit for second quarter is at INR173.30 crores as against INR139.93 crores of the corresponding quarter in the previous year.
During H1 FY27, revenue grew by 20% to INR99.91 crores, as compared to INR83.52 crores in the previous year.
Consequently, the total income increased by 16% to INR107.70 crores compared to INR92.84 crores in the previous year.
Profit after tax for H1 FY27 stood at INR23.74 crores compared to INR27.09 crores in H1 '26, representing a decline of 12%.
